Time and tools

Prep templates get three questions of their own: where they live, editing one, and making a session from one (with Re-apply). Then the calendar, a record on the timeline, and the Codex's tools (backup, restore, bringing in notes, autosave and history). Five options for each, every one built from what is already settled (listed under Carried in), so they differ in arrangement, not in look. The first is today's drawn to the theme. Setting your date and a player's Compendium in the Codex follow the rules. The seventh switch is a check, not a choice: the replays as you mixed them last round, drawn from their approved mockup. Scroll past the switches and a compact bar keeps the page and its options in reach.
